source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A full border of 2s marks the direction in which the objects settle.
    if all(v == 2 for v in grid[0]):
        dr, dc, key = -1, 0, lambda cells: min(r for r, c in cells)
    elif all(v == 2 for v in grid[-1]):
        dr, dc, key = 1, 0, lambda cells: -max(r for r, c in cells)
    elif all(row[0] == 2 for row in grid):
        dr, dc, key = 0, -1, lambda cells: min(c for r, c in cells)
    elif all(row[-1] == 2 for row in grid):
        dr, dc, key = 0, 1, lambda cells: -max(c for r, c in cells)
    else:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or color == 2 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            todo = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while todo:
                x, y = todo.pop()
                cells.append((x, y))
                for nx, ny in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
                    if 0 <= nx < h and 0 <= ny < w and (nx,ny) not in seen and grid[nx][ny] == color:
                        seen.add((nx,ny))
                        todo.append((nx,ny))
            objects.append((color, cells))

    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: key(obj[1]))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color, cells in objects:
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c] = 0
    # Settle objects one at a time, nearest the border first.
    placed = []
    for color, original in objects:
        cells = list(original)
        while True:
            moved = [(r+dr, c+dc) for r,c in cells]
            if any(r < 0 or r >= h or c < 0 or c >= w or grid[r][c] == 2 for r,c in moved):
                break
            if any((r,c) in occ for r,c in moved for occ in placed):
                break
            cells = moved
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r][c] = color
        placed.append(set(cells))
    return out
'''
